---
title: "Stacked bar plot DE miRNAs per chromosome"
author: "Pablo Domizi"
date: "2024-12-21"
output: html_document
---

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(readxl)
```

```{r}
data <- read_excel("miRNA DEA/miRNA_TSGs_summary_25Dec2024.xlsx", sheet = 2)

data
```

```{r}
ggdf <- data |>
  pivot_longer(where(is.double), names_to = "Category", values_to = "n") |>
  mutate(Chromosome = factor(Chromosome),
         Category = factor(Category, levels = c("TSG on chr", "On chr", "Others"))) |>
  mutate(Chromosome = relevel(Chromosome, ref = "chr1p"))
```


```{r}
ggdf |>
ggplot(aes(x = Chromosome, y = n, fill = Category)) +
  geom_bar(position="fill", stat="identity") +
  theme_classic() +
  ylab("Frequency DEG") +
  theme(axis.title.x = element_blank()) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("#00468b", "#add8e6", "#d3d3d3"))
ggsave("miRNA DEA/Barplots_DE_miRNA_on_deletected_chr.pdf")
```
